definitions.explanation: The long, narrow top of a mountain or hill, forming a continuous elevated crest between peaks.

examples.japanese: {尾根|おね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
{尾根|おね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}せた→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧。
examples.english: I could see the scenery spread out from the ridge.

examples.japanese: {尾根|おね}{伝|づた}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I made my way along the ridge toward the next summit.

notes:
A term commonly used in hiking and mountaineering. The ridge is the elevated line connecting peaks, and ridge walks ({尾根|おね}⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧) are a popular style of mountain hiking in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尾根|おね}⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ — ridge trail
- {尾根|おね}⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ — ridge walking
- {尾根|おね}{伝|づた}い — along the ridge
- {尾根|おね}⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ — ridgeline
- {痩|や}せ{尾根|おね} — narrow ridge (dangerous terrain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {稜線|りょうせん} — ridgeline (more technical/literary)
- ⟦{峰|みね}→峰：23001_mine⟧ — peak, summit
- ⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧ — valley (opposite: the low point between ridges)
